name: Mariner 2
about: Mariner 2 (1962 A RHO 1, NASA/JPL), launched 1962 Aug 27. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
